neighbours.label: A closing greeting or signature: 'Love from', 'Liebe Grüße', 'Grüsse von', 'Aloha from', 'From your Valentine'; ' from' and ' von' with their ordinary meaning stay quiet
fire:
Have a lovely day.
Love from Anna and the kids
The card was signed "From your loving son."

Vielen Dank für alles.
Liebe Grüße Petra
Herzliche Grüße von Hans und Maria
Aloha from Maui and see you soon

See you in spring.
Best wishes from all of us
quiet:
